rows.label: qst650606_msg0001
rows.name: Sir[ML:Dash ]

rows.label: qst650606_msg0002
rows.name:
The bandits said they stole this
eight years ago.

rows.label: qst650606_msg0003
rows.name: What do you make of that?

rows.label: qst650606_msg0004
rows.name:
Hmm. Perhaps they've done so many
similar things that they can't
tell one incident from another.

rows.label: qst650606_msg0005
rows.name: I see. That may well be it.

rows.label: qst650606_msg0006
rows.name: Um, what's this little one's name?

rows.label: qst650606_msg0007
rows.name: A name[ML:Dash ]? Never thought of one.

rows.label: qst650606_msg0008
rows.name: Just 'No. 777, made by Lazaro'[ML:Dash ]

rows.label: qst650606_msg0009
rows.name:
That sounds like a machine's
model number!

rows.label: qst650606_msg0010
rows.name: I know! Can I call this one Lucky?

rows.label: qst650606_msg0011
rows.name: Since it's number 777, Lucky!

rows.label: qst650606_msg0012
rows.name: Lucky[ML:Dash ] What a fine name.

rows.label: qst650606_msg0013
rows.name:
Thank you for giving this one
such a lovely name.

rows.label: qst650606_msg0014
rows.name: From today on, this one is Lucky.

rows.label: qst650606_msg0015
rows.name: Such a lovely name! I'm jealous, mo!

rows.label: qst650606_msg0016
rows.name: Hana, you didn't like your name, mo!?

rows.label: qst650606_msg0017
rows.name:
Everyone, I hate to ask again,
but could you take Lucky
to my daughter[ML:Dash ]

rows.label: qst650606_msg0018
rows.name: To Rose, if you would?

rows.label: qst650606_msg0019
rows.name: She's in Luxuria.

rows.label: qst650606_msg0020
rows.name: Why not take Lucky there yourself?

rows.label: qst650606_msg0021
rows.name: I would, but[ML:Dash ]

rows.label: qst650606_msg0022
rows.name:
I've been away for so long
that I can't face my daughter.

rows.label: qst650606_msg0023
rows.name: Oh, is that so?

rows.label: qst650606_msg0024
rows.name: Why not?

rows.label: qst650606_msg0025
rows.name:
We've come this far.
Let's see it through to the end.

rows.label: qst650606_msg0026
rows.name: Oh, thank you so very much[ML:Dash ]

rows.label: qst650606_msg0027
rows.name:
Lazaro-san said Rose-san is at
Elmu Square in Luxuria's capital.

rows.label: qst650606_msg0028
rows.name: All right, let's take Lucky there!
